description: Reports an escrow's status, plus a live solvency check on the buyer: does the wallet still hold the amount, and is the payment authorization still valid on-chain. Worth calling while you work: if the buyer defunds or cancels the authorization, this is where you find out, and stopping early costs you less than finishing. Requires either party's token.

token.description: Your buyer_token or seller_token for this escrow.

name: escrow_get
